definitionZh: 面具型CSS属性适用于SVG元素. 它定义是使用面具的亮度(亮度)还是α(透明)内容. 这种财产可能被面具模式财产所压倒。 面具类型的属性对图像或梯度面具没有影响.
sourceDefinition: The mask-type CSS property applies to the SVG element. It defines whether to use the luminance (brightness) or alpha (transparency) content of the mask. This property may be overridden by the mask-mode property. The mask-type property has no effect on image or gradient masks.
